skill.name: AI Team Build Skill
skill.description: Builds complete agent-readable AI team skills from a team specification.

methods.label: Manual directory copy
instructions: Copy this repository directory into your agent skills root using your platform's file manager or deployment tool.
Run npm test from the copied directory before registering the skill.

agentHints.environmentPolicy: Run Node scripts from the skill root. Core generation must not require network access or credentials.
agentHints.generationPolicy: Create or review a v2 team-spec.json before generating files. The Agent owns semantic team design; deterministic scripts synthesize, generate, validate, and score. Domain packs enhance known domains, while unknown domains use a controlled value-chain draft. Default output is <skills-root>/<skill.id> unless the spec or command sets another output directory.
agentHints.executionPolicy: Generated teams must select complexity, executionProfile, rolePlan, and target verification level before execution. Every generated team receives decision, risk, handoff, evidence, delivery, and workflow-status governance assets.
agentHints.roleActivationPolicy: Treat workflow members as a candidate pool. Only active and consulted roles participate; not_applicable roles require scenario evidence and must be reassessed when scope or risk changes.
agentHints.verificationPolicy: Factory validation is V2 contract verification. A generated team's real domain capability starts at V0 and may only advance with task-specific evidence; an A-grade blueprint is not business-outcome certification.
agentHints.skillEvolutionPolicy: For existing Skill audits, run scripts/audit-skills.js before changing the target. The audit is static-only and must not execute target scripts or external side effects. For team skills, distinguish candidate members from active, consulted, and not_applicable roles in rolePlan. Prioritize P0/P1 before P2, run target verification only after environment and side-effect boundaries are confirmed, then re-audit.
agentHints.externalSkillPolicy: Generated team skills may declare external skills, but installation requires explicit user authorization.

privacy.policy: Do not store environment-specific, locally downloaded, private, or company-internal skill names in generated runtime files.
